decisions.reason: The coffee-based men's series opens a new target group for a firm with a narrow range, so it remains an inexpensive option with unresolved upside, although niche men's lines in natural cosmetics often underperform and no evidence after 2019 confirms traction.

The cleansing foam extends the established Sandorini series and shares its formulas, production and channels, so carrying it costs little and there is no sign that its value has failed to materialize.
